headlines.description: — Lukas Reichel had a goal and an assist in his Boston debut, Jeremy Swayman made 22 saves and the Bruins beat the Winnipeg Jets 6-1 on Thursday night to end a two-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reichel has goal an assist in Boston debut to help the Bruins beat the Jets 6-1

events.name: New York Islanders at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Brady Tkachuk scored with 11.1 seconds left to give the Ottawa Senators a 3-2 victory over the New York Islanders on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tkachuk scores with 11.1 seconds left to lift the Senators past the Islanders, 3-2

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Alex DeBrincat scored the go-ahead goal with 3:25 remaining and assisted on Detroit's two other goals, lifting the Red Wings to a 3-1 victory over the Montreal Canadiens on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeBrincat scores go-ahead goal and has two assists in Red Wings' 3-1 victory over Canadiens

events.name: New York Rangers at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Adam Fantilli scored twice, including an empty-net goal with 2:54 remaining, and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the New York Rangers 6-3 on Thursday night, keeping alive hopes for their first playoff berth since the 2019-20 season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fantilli leads Blue Jackets over Rangers 6-3 as Columbus moves into playoff spot

headlines.description: — Connor Bedard scored a goal and defenseman Alex Vlasic made a game-saving stop as time ran out on Thursday night as the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Minnesota Wild 2-1 to snap the NHL's longest active point streak for one team against another.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bedard scores, Blackhawks hang for first win over Wild in seven years

headlines.description: — Filip Forsberg scored a goal and added two assists and Justus Annunen made 25 saves to lead the Nashville Predators to a 3-1 victory over the Seattle Kraken on Thursday night in a matchup of teams vying for a Western Conference wild card.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsberg, Annunen lead Predators over Kraken 3-1

headlines.description: — Sergei Bobrovsky made 21 saves to earn his fourth shutout of the season as the Florida Panthers continued to plague Edmonton, emerging with a 4-0 victory over the Oilers on Thursday in a rematch of the last two Stanley Cup finals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sergei Bobrovsky perfect in net as Panthers blank Oilers 4-0

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov and Anthony Cirelli each had a goal and two assists and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the NHL-worst Vancouver Canucks 6-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kucherov, Cirelli lead the Lightning past the NHL-worst Canucks, 6-2

events.name: Utah Mammoth at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Karel Vejmelka stopped all 28 shots he faced for Utah, while Vegas counterpart Adin Hill was chased after allowing three goals without making a save in the Mammoth's 4-0 victory over the Golden Knights on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mammoth score on 1st 3 shots on goal in 4-0 win over the Golden Knights

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Alex Lyon made 23 saves for his 10th straight road victory as the Buffalo Sabres scored three times in a span of less than two minutes in the second period to beat the San Jose Sharks 5-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Lyon earns 10th straight road win as the Sabres beat the Sharks 5-0

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Trevor Zegras and Matvei Michkov scored in a shootout to give the Philadelphia Flyers their fourth victory in five games, 4-3 over the Los Angeles Kings on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flyers outlast Kings 4-3 in shootout for their 4th victory in 5 games
